'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Neil Smith LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Neil Smith]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

No deck title on sheet. Partner Dark sheet not adjacent in fax (hub — until found).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Neil Smith]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Power Of The Senate|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
